headline: India's benchmark indexes set for a muted start
summary: India's benchmark indexes are set for a muted start on Wednesday, tracking other Asian peers, after upbeat U.S. data pointed to a strong economy and bolstered the case for fewer rate cuts from the Federal Reserve.
